title: NiSource releases 2025 Sustainability Report, highlighting progress to shape a more sustainable energy future
summary: MERRILLVILLE, Ind. — NiSource Inc. (NYSE: NI) today released its 2025 Sustainability Report, Energizing a Sustainable Future, outlining achievements that help shape a safer, more resilient energy environment for the customers and communities we serve.
body_markdown:
**MERRILLVILLE, Ind.** — NiSource Inc. (NYSE: NI) today released its 2025 Sustainability Report, **[Energizing a Sustainable Future](https://www.nisource.com/docs/librariesprovider2/sustainability-archives/2025/nisource2025sustainabilityreport.pdf)** , outlining achievements that help shape a safer, more resilient energy environment for the customers and communities we serve.


In 2025, NiSource continued to connect day-to-day operations with long-term sustainability goals to drive value for customers and shareholders. Among the key achievements, we reduced environmental impacts across our operating footprint, celebrated a key safety milestone, and launched an innovative business model that protects customers and supports large-load energy growth.


"Sustainability is central to how NiSource plans, operates and grows,” said Lloyd Yates, president and chief executive officer of NiSource. "It guides how we invest in our communities and develop innovative energy solutions that create long-term value for customers and shareholders."


NiSource reported the following achievements in 2025 across environmental, social and governance priorities, including:


- Earned a place on the Dow Jones Best-in-Class Indices for the 12th consecutive year and reaffirmation to the FTSE4Good Index Series


- Achieved top-quintile ratings on average across sustainability raters, including an MSCI AAA ESG rating for the fifth consecutive year
- Nearly doubled renewable energy storage capacity with the installation of more than 1,500 MW of solar, wind and battery storage capacity
- Received regulatory approval for an innovative business model that supports responsible energy growth and will return more than $1 billion to customers
- Launched Project ReSource, a company-wide initiative to reduce waste and create value through circular economy practices
- Recorded zero serious employee injuries or fatalities, reflecting NiSource's deep commitment to protecting employees
- Expanded Environmental Action Grants throughout our operating region, funding programs for habitat conservation and restoration, education, and outdoor recreation


“Sustainability is part of the work of serving customers. It shows up in the decisions we make to keep service safe and reliable, help customers manage energy costs and keep up with growing energy demand,” said Melody Birmingham, executive vice president and group president, utilities. "This report reflects the progress we’ve made through disciplined execution and a steady focus on our communities.”


The full report is available at[www.nisource.com](https://www.nisource.com/home) .


**About NiSource**


NiSource Inc. (NYSE: NI) is one of the largest fully-regulated utility companies in the United States, serving approximately 3.3 million natural gas customers and 500,000 electric customers across six states through its local Columbia Gas and NIPSCO brands. The mission of our approximately 7,700 employees is to deliver safe, reliable energy that drives value to our customers. NiSource is a member of the Dow Jones Sustainability - North America Index and is on Forbes lists of America’s Best Employers for Women and Diversity. Learn more about NiSource’s record of leadership in sustainability, investments in the communities it serves and how we live our vision to be an innovative and trusted energy partner at[www.nisource.com](https://www.nisource.com/home) .
